notes.title: Even more stable and new things to do!
notes.content:
Solved a lot of bugs, added new way to explore and find collectible items, added new spells and improve stable!

Now the game even include a mini tutorial at the beginning!

notes.title: Here we are!
notes.content:
[b]Good morning, little foxes![/b]

Finally the new update is available, full of news!
In fact, in addition to those already announced, there are more!

Full changelog:
-Possibility to play on 32-bit x86
-Added the Ragdoll physic! It will be more fun to kill the enemies
-Improved artificial intelligence of enemies
-Dialogues improved
-Improve the information in the game
-Improved graphics with low detail
-Improved audio
-Improved combat
-Added different spells of attack and defense
-Fixed the problem to magic staffs
-Level of difficulty set
-Lighter to load
-Many big Bugs resolved
-Improved FPS !!!
-Water redone
-New Physics!
-New targeting method
-Improved commands
-Improved graphics
-Improved collisions
-Other small fixes

Attention, the update is very heavy and may make you lose the old saves. Indeed it is recommended to start a new game, I apologize for the inconvenience but the update has changed several foundations of the game!

Thank you everyone! ♥

notes.title: Almost Ready
notes.content:
[b]Hi little foxes![/b]

After several months working every day, I announce that the new big update is almost ready!
- Many big Bugs resolved
- More interesting bats
-Improved FPS !!!
- Water redone
-New Physics!
- New targeting method
-Improved commands
- Improved graphics
-Improved collisions
- Other small fixes

Thank you very much to all of you who are helping me in the realization of this great project!

notes.title: So many update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

These days I worked a lot, after collecting your opinions, to fix several bugs and improve the general experience of the game. I hope you can enjoy the updates that include:
- Life system has been revolutionized
- FPS improvement
- Improved HUD graphics
-Suplify the first missions
- Fixed many bugs
- Improved overall stability

I look forward to receiving your opinions! Enjoy the game!

Thank you all my friend!

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.content: My friends, I am proud to present you early access to the game that is taking me every day and night of my life, hoping you will enjoy it! There is little left to the possibility of downloading it, please, follow us!
